build_SSD3DNet_model: build an SSD3DNet 3D object detector model with a backbone and bounding box head
review_SSD3DNet_init: review the SSD3DNet class init that delegates backbone and bbox_head to VoteNet parent
test_SSD3DNet_forward_train: test the SSD3DNet forward_train method with 3D points and ground truth boxes
test_SSD3DNet_simple_test: test the SSD3DNet simple_test method to predict 3D bounding boxes from point clouds
test_SSD3DNet_aug_test: test the SSD3DNet aug_test method for augmented 3D bounding box predictions
